summary: This ECB Financial Stability Review special feature examines the relationship between market liquidity and funding liquidity in the euro area. The paper constructs composite indicators for both liquidity dimensions and analyzes how they interact to potentially generate liquidity spirals. The authors identify structural factors (market-making practices, issue size, trade transparency, investor landscape) and cyclical determinants (risk appetite, macroeconomic conditions, monetary policy cycles) that affect liquidity conditions.
